description: A worker resource on a live stack: scaffold with tdk resource --type worker, tdk up, the worker is listed as a worker in tdk status, its container logged its start line, tdk restart replaces the container, and one error envelope when Tilt is unreachable (openspec task 3.6, #1290; #1294). The scaffolded worker is a stub that exits after logging, so processing a job is not covered.
